purpose: Short architecture training-throughput benchmark, not a biological model-training run
inputs: Synthetic prepacked fixed-shape token IDs; measures training compute, not corpus loader speed or learning quality
precision: BF16 forward/backward compute, FP32 master parameters and AdamW optimizer states
distributed: Plain model on one GPU; FSDP FULL_SHARD across decoder blocks on multiple GPUs

reporting.transitions: Publish promptly on failure, completion or job-state changes
reporting.delivery: GitHub report and local status history; proactive chat notifications are not configured

authorization: User explicitly requested starting the matched2B200 versus8A100 tests. Each allocation is capped at20minutes; no full training run or changes to evaluation jobs.
extrapolation: 200B divided by measured aggregate input tokens per second at the measured allocation only; queueing, data preparation, checkpointing and convergence are separate
profile_selection: Best fully completed matched-batch profile; retain failures, partials and skipped profiles
prior_baseline: One B200 measured at global batch4sequences; context only, not a matched scaling comparison

admission.policy: Wait for observed spare GPUs, CPUs and memory; pin checked node and require no proposed scheduler preemptions before release
admission.on_wait_deadline: Leave unstarted requests held and publish admission expiry; do not extend GPU runtime
admission.caveat: Observations and release are not atomic; this reduces disruption risk but cannot guarantee against scheduler races
